definitions.explanation: Describes prices or costs that are shockingly high. An emphatic, informal expression stronger than simply 高い.

examples.japanese: このレストランは{激高|げきたか}だ。
{修理|しゅうり}{代|だい}が{激高|げきたか}で{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was shocked at the sky-high repair cost.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}の{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}は{激高|げきたか}なので、もう{少|すこ}し{遠|とお}い{所|ところ}に{停|と}めよう。
examples.english: The parking lot in front of the station is outrageously expensive, so let's park somewhere a bit farther away.

notes:
Composed of {激|げき} (extreme, intense) + {高|たか} (high, expensive). An informal, emphatic expression used to describe prices that feel shockingly high. Part of a productive pattern where {激|げき} intensifies adjectives.

The {激|げき}〜 INTENSIFIER PATTERN:
- {激安|げきやす}: dirt cheap
- {激高|げきたか}: sky-high expensive
- {激辛|げきから}: extremely spicy
- {激甘|げきあま}: extremely sweet
- {激混|げきこ}み: extremely crowded
- {激レア|げきれあ}: extremely rare

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {激高|げきたか}の{店|みせ}: an extremely expensive shop
- {激高|げきたか}な{料金|りょうきん}: outrageously high fees
- {激高|げきたか}で{手|て}が{出|で}ない: so expensive one can't afford it

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {高額|こうがく}: high price — neutral, formal term for a large monetary amount
- {高|たか}い: expensive — the standard adjective, without the emphatic shock value
- {法外|ほうがい}: exorbitant — formal; implies the price is unreasonably or unjustly high
